svg.text: 4b. Team Arena, three friends joined by code

g.text: Heroes' Ascent and GvG open this screen too: the side size and the goal line (relic and altars, guild banner) change, nothing else.
Pick a side. The host sets how many bots fill each side. Everyone Ready starts the match.
Unchanged from today, but the title bar now carries the code, so the lobby heading drops its own Copy button.
1. Who picks the mode: the host only. A guest's icons are dimmed and locked; the active one shows what the host chose.
2. Joining someone else's lobby: your own lobby closes. The friends in it fall back to their own lobbies, and Leave takes you back to yours.
3. Team Builder: a side pane at the right of the Team Lobby, both always in view.

svg.text: 4b. Team Arena, three friends joined by code

g.text: Heroes' Ascent and GvG open this screen too: the side size and the goal line (relic and altars, guild banner) change, nothing else.
Pick a side. The host sets how many bots fill each side. Everyone Ready starts the match.
Unchanged from today, but the title bar now carries the code, so the lobby heading drops its own Copy button.
1. Who picks the mode: anyone in the lobby. The last click wins and the lobby shows who switched it, so a party can not be locked out by an idle host.
2. Joining someone else's lobby: your own lobby stays open with its friends, run by nobody until you come back; Leave returns you to it.
3. Team Builder: a tab beside the Team Lobby, so each gets the full width; the tab shows the lit build's name.

b. a friend's code being typed: Join is lit

svg.text: 4b. Team Arena, three friends joined by code

g.text: Heroes' Ascent and GvG open this screen too: the side size and the goal line (relic and altars, guild banner) change, nothing else.
Pick a side. The host sets how many bots fill each side. Everyone Ready starts the match.
Unchanged from today, but the title bar now carries the code, so the lobby heading drops its own Copy button.
1. Who picks the mode: the host only. A guest sees the rail lit on the host's mode and dimmed, and can look but not click.
2. Joining someone else's lobby: your whole party goes with you, as a party does in the games this is copied from. Leave brings it back to your code.
3. Team Builder: below the Team Lobby, a strip of build cards that scrolls down the page.
